summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Little Legacy Learners™ Studio (PHASE 1 FOUNDATION) at /little-legacy. All 6 test areas verified end-to-end using the real preview URL, logged in as Founder. Navigation, all 5 tabs (Overview, Universe Bible, Characters, Stories, Governance), all 4 metric cards, all 6 character bibles, all 6 governance checklists, Universe Bible approval, Character Bible approval, and both critical Knowledge-First acceptance tests PASSED.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: missing 'Description' or aria-describedby (accessibility warning, non-blocking). Reported by React console.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to KnowledgePicker's DialogContent to silence Radix accessibility warning.
critical_code_review_comments: LittleLegacyStudio.js is clean, single-responsibility, ~340 lines — well within limits.

Character keys are seeded with dashes (e.g. 'bella-butterfly'), so data-testid 'll-approve-character-bella-butterfly' — matches the pattern 'll-approve-character-<key>' from the spec. (Spec examples used underscores, but the contract 'key from backend' is honored — no bug.)

EpisodeCreator posts kr_id: kr?.id || null when no KR is picked, and the backend correctly returns ok:false with a Knowledge-First warning message — surfaces via toast.warning. Good governance behaviour.
KnowledgePicker in LittleLegacyStudio uses verifiedOnly=true so only verified KRs appear — matches Knowledge-First principle.
seed_data_creation: One episode blueprint was created via the UI titled 'TEST_Episode_Acceptance' using verified KR 'What Is Governance?' with featured character Nova Sparkle. Universe Bible was approved to v1.0. Bella Butterfly Character Bible was Founder-approved to v1.0. These are governance-approved state changes that main agent said are expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Little Legacy Studio PHASE 1 fully verified via UI. Universe Bible v1.0 is now Approved, Bella Butterfly v1.0 is Founder-approved, and there are now 2 episode blueprints (1 pre-existing 'Governance Adventure' + 1 test 'TEST_Episode_Acceptance'). If retesting is needed, use another character (Nova Sparkle / Sunny Bee / Tilly Turtle / Eli Elephant / Rio Rainbow) for approval-button visibility.
